resources.string: PlayPKM is a mobile application designed to challenge your Pokémon knowledge. It also allows you to compete in a global ranking with other players.
Challenge the 12 daily minigames and climb to the top of the global ranking. Minigames reset every day at 00:00 UTC (follow the timer on screen).
A cropped part of the body will be revealed; you need to know which Pokémon it is.
To complete the easiest game, you must guess the Pokémon silhouette against the clock.
Try to guess the Pokémon hidden in the blurred card!
Can you remember one ability of today’s Pokémon?
Guess the move’s power! It’s not as easy as it seems…
A truly difficult game! You will have 3 lives to guess the Pokémon behind those stats.
Show that you can recognize the two Pokémon that have been fused together!
You will see 3 Pokémon and one specific stat… Which one has the highest base value in that stat?
You will see 1 ability and 5 Pokémon… Find the only one that does not have that ability!
This minigame can be played UNLIMITED times! Choose the strongest Pokémon and achieve your highest score. It does not grant points for the global ranking.
This minigame can be played UNLIMITEDLY! Guess the Pokémon and get your highest score. It does not award points for the global ranking.
This minigame can be played UNLIMITEDLY! Guess the Pokémon and get your highest score. It does not award points for the global ranking.
For a better experience, it is recommended to set your screen size to the lower half.
Leaving a review on the Play Store helps a lot. Share your opinion, suggestions, bug reports, or ideas for the future.
The illustrations used in the Power of Move minigame belong to the official Pokémon video games and are used solely for illustrative purposes. Screenshots belong to WIKIDEX.
The illustrations used in the Fusion! minigame belong to Infinite Fusion Calculator and are used solely for illustrative purposes.
The rest of the images are obtained through the official Pokémon API, provided publicly by The Pokémon Company for development purposes.
The music belongs to Cindery, we invite you to listen to her covers on YouTube!
